contracts: GetBox/WhichMouseTabCol give represented resize classification priority before enhanced selection. SelTableRowCol projects a captured drag onto the nearest edge of original master/follows, retains the actual original table and chooses native simple row/column model selection. Actual table cursor/rings continue to own formatting/list/clipboard/edit/history. Same endpoint section admits unchanged selection.

SwEditWin MouseButtonDown only admits single left click outside other native modes, enters standard mode,selects via persistent shell,captures row/column start and extends on mouse move. Native desktop modes absent from existing browser runtime remain unverified; no synthetic widget or node-index row adapter retained.
DOM supplies device rectangles/events only. Global capture and teardown are platform seams. Browser-only fixed ruler/canvas scrolling is exercised by real E2E gestures; no core injection.

RTL/vertical/nested/merged/rowspan/protected/native resize operations and full native frame hierarchy are not silently promoted. Full core/UI parity remains unverified; historical classifications/defaults and conscious I/O/recovery exceptions retained.
